name: Cassiopeia (a Shooting Star addon)
description: An unofficial addon for The Shooting Star [Demo]. Adds SC-01 Cassiopeia to the Stellar Remote: the W of five bright stars is drawn on the ground in light, then the stars burst out of the ground one by one, dimmest first, each leaving a crater and a glowing star core and rising to hang in the sky, and starlight veins brand the constellation into the land.
